text: Twenty two banks. One question. For every hundred rupees of new deposits, how much did they lend?
Clue one. Union Bank, two hundred and thirteen. Karnataka Bank, one forty nine. Equitas, one thirty eight.
Clue two. At the other end, Bank of India and IDBI, seventy nine.
The twist. Thirteen of twenty two lent more than they raised. That works, until deposits get expensive.
Find your bank. Pause the video. Back to the napkin.
